Lamp Bible is made by TheWay in Big Rapids, Michigan, to help children read God’s Word for themselves. “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.” Psalm 119:105

How it works

Tap a word to hear it and see it split into sounds. Press Sound it out to light up each sound, one at a time.

Tap a verse number to hear the verse, try a harder version of it, or see the KJV.

Start is one short sentence per verse for your child to read, with the KJV underneath for you to read right after. Level 1 is about 1st grade, Level 2 is about 2nd to 3rd grade, and KJV is the King James text. Every level keeps the same verse numbers as the KJV.

Each chapter has words to know at the top, Think about it questions after each story, a memory verse with a hide-the-words game, and an I read it! star at the end.
